description: Legal notice period for a termination (UAE Art. 43: 30–90 days as agreed; probation Art. 9: 14 days employer / 30 or 14 days employee; Saudi Art. 75: 60 days employer, 30 days employee from 19 Feb 2025), the date notice ends, and pay in lieu. Example: country 'SA', party 'employee', on_date '2026-11-01', monthly_wage 9000.  Response: result with legal_basis (article) and explanation[] steps, data_confidence (high = official text; medium = translation or recent amendment via secondary source), estimated_items[], sources[] (law URLs), data_version, warnings[] and a not-legal-advice disclaimer.
